query: Panama City Beach alcohol allowed year round except March ordinance
information:
### Page note: https://www.visitpanamacitybeach.com/stay-pcb-current/knowbeforeyougo/
Reader state: complete; relevance: partial
**Page:** Know Before You Go Guide | Panama City Beach – https://www.visitpanamacitybeach.com/stay-pcb-current/knowbeforeyougo/

**Evidence**

| Entity | Condition | Dates | Unit |
|--------|-----------|-------|------|
| Panama City Beach (sandy beaches) | Alcohol is **not** permitted | March 1 – March 31 | - |
| March (Month) | Alcohol prohibition applies | March 1 – March 31 | - |

**Coverage**  
The page supplies a single condition that alcohol is not permitted on Panama City Beach’s sandy beaches during the calendar month of March (March 1–31). No other dates, units, or entities regarding alcohol consumption are provided, nor is a statement that alcohol is permitted in the other months.

**Missing**  
* Confirmation that alcohol consumption is allowed **outside of March**.  
* Identification of other beaches in Florida that fit the same “year‑round except March” rule.  
* Any legal or regulatory documentation that defines the broader policy on beach alcohol.
